summary: Iteration 26 - Profitability & channel fees + orders customer/print-label. Backend pytest (5/5) validates GET /api/marketplace/profitability structure (total, channels with fee_settings & channel_id, orders with all fee fields, top_products, low_margin), calculation correctness for a Trendyol order (commission = revenue * rate/100, commission_vat = commission * 20%, sale_vat = revenue - revenue/1.2, net formula), exclusion of b2b/manual channels and cancelled/returned orders, PUT /api/integrations/ecommerce/{id}/fees update-then-recompute cycle, invalid (150 / -1) → 400 and unknown channel → 404. Restored trendyol fees to commission_rate=21.5 & service_fee=12.99. Frontend Playwright verified: /orders order-customer-11571862893 click navigates to /contacts?search=Mustafa%20Bal (goContact works); print-label single order opens new window with title 'Kargo Etiketleri (1)' and 1 .label section; tab-profit reveals profitability-panel with profit-days selector, all four profit-total-* cards, profit-channel-trendyol card, fee-editor-trendyol; changing fee-commission-trendyol from 21.5→30 and clicking fee-save-trendyol triggers toast 'Trendyol komisyon ayarları kaydedildi.' — restored to 21.5 afterwards; 21 profit-row-* rows rendered; regression tabs (tab-claims, tab-cancelled, tab-questions, tab-orders) still open; real Trendyol order 11571862893 preserved.
